title: Time-Lapse Video Microscopy for Assessment of Self-Renewal and Division Kinetics
protocol: Obtain fresh sorted cancer cell populations immediately after FACS.
Keep cells in phenol red-free media.
Seed cancer cells at 5-10% confluency in 100mm vacuum gas plasma-treated plates.
Incubate cells at standard culture conditions of 37°C, 5% CO2.
Allow 4-8 hours for cells to adhere.
Acquire first image using both brightfield and fluorescence filters.
Set microscope to acquire images every 10 minutes for a period of 72 hours.
Assemble movie of individual images using ImageJ Java-based software.
Observe for anaphase in the parent cell to track individual cell divisions.
Record the time to first division (doubling time).
Observe for anaphase in the daughter cells from the original parent cell.
Record the time to first division of these daughter cells.
Determine if there are significant differences in doubling times between the different subsets of cells and between the two daughters from a single parent stem cell from each subset.
Observe for asymmetric versus symmetric distribution of fluorescence in the daughter cell after division of the parent cell.
Note for cell death in the daughter cells.
